name: VetoScan
description: Explainable heuristic screening for known prompt-injection patterns in text and public HTTPS page content, with redacted output and source offsets.

operations.name: scanUntrustedContent
operations.input: exactly one of {text: string} or {url: public HTTPS URL}
operations.output: JSON verdict, review-priority score, total finding count, up to 50 evidence details and offsets, text redacted for every finding, truncation indicator, limitations

payment.reason: No payment-provider account, stablecoin access approval, facilitator credentials, deposit address, listing, or deployment has been configured or approved.

limitations: Rule-based detections are incomplete and can miss novel or context-dependent attacks.
Explicit email-send requests in untrusted content may be flagged for review even when legitimate.
A no_known_pattern verdict is not a safety certification.
The local server listens only on 127.0.0.1 and must not be exposed publicly.
